name: openpencil
description: Create, inspect, preview, and save editable OpenPencil designs with Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Design editable UI on your local OpenPencil canvas
interface.longDescription: Open a complete editable Rust canvas for your conversation, or connect to your existing editor. Interactive edits and Codex tools share one document, with guarded saves and recovery drafts. Requires Node.js 22+ and a configured complete Rust runtime for the canvas, or a running desktop MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Open an interactive OpenPencil canvas for this conversation.
Create a single-page dashboard in OpenPencil.
Inspect and refine the selected OpenPencil frame.
